description: Repairs r-def-cursor-dao/err-index-over-duplicates: two failing statements ran before one Errors read, so the first failure's number was only in its EXCEPINFO; the CREATE INDEX of the second pass failed 3211 because the snapshot sr was open on T. Errors read; Database.Execute of "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_TN_dup ON T (N)" (N holds 40 twice), Errors read; Execute of "ALTER TABLE H ADD CONSTRAINT PK_H PRIMARY KEY (A)" (A holds 1 twice), Errors read; a snapshot of T opened and CLOSED, Errors read; the two statements again, each followed by its own Errors read; then the Indexes of T and of H (after Refresh) read. Asks the Number of each failure on its own, in both passes, and whether any index was left behind. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
